author: ChusenTheCate
body:
Hello, I'm Chusen99 and I'm from Argentina, any gramatical errors I do is simply because english is not my native language. I want the mods to please take a good look at what I'm going to write now.

As you have seen, you can take a look at my infractions and I'm banned forever. I just wanna say I am really, really sorry for this because for doing that stupidity now I can't play this server, which I really liked.

This happened an year ago, and I'd like you to know that I've changed. Even if my ban doesn't get appealed, I wanna let you know I'm not anymore that person, that hacked in a server.

I just want to get the opportunity to start from zero, I wanna get back to this server, I don't care about my kills or my deaths, if they get erased, but I'd like to play back again in this server, without doing any ban evasions or any of those stupid things I don't like to do right now, because maybe an year ago, when I got banned, I maybe liked hacking, and ban evading (which I didn't do), and insulting people. Well right now, I don't like doing that. I just wanna play this server like a normal player, without using hacks or anything else.

I hope you read this and think it well. The only thing I can say is that I'll never use any hacks back again in this, or any servers in minecraft.

I'm sorry about this.
Chusen99.
